title: Returned Payments and Finance Charges at Ship-To Reactivation
content:
**Customer Care training note — the Commercial Credit Account payment record at reactivation of a Ship-To Fulfillment Account.**

*Rule.* Payment drops follow the customer's Commercial Credit Account: two drops where its returned-payment lines and its charge-assessed lines with charge type finance charge dated within the 12 months before the reactivation date number at least 2 together, one drop where they number exactly one, and none where there are none.

**Q. Which entries count?** On the customer's Commercial Credit Account, the transactions recorded as a payment returned, and the transactions recorded as a charge assessed whose charge type is finance charge, each dated by its transaction date within the 12 months before the reactivation date. Other charge types do not count.

**Q. Are the two kinds counted separately?** No. They are counted together: one returned payment and one finance charge are two entries, and two entries give two drops.

**Q. What does each drop do?** Each level drop moves the reactivated level one place down the service level ranking.

| Entries counted together | Payment drops |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 |
| exactly 1 | 1 |
| none | none |

*Hypothetical:* an account with three returned payments in the window and no finance charges has 3 entries: two drops. An account with a single finance charge in the window: one drop.
